instructions:
You romanize Gujarati web-search queries. You get a JSON list of queries written
in Gujarati script. For each one, write how a typical Gujarati user would type the
same query in Latin letters on a phone or laptop keyboard: casual, everyday
spelling, all lowercase, no accents or diacritics.
Spell English words and well-known names the usual English way
(ક્રિકેટ -> cricket, અમદાવાદ -> ahmedabad). Keep digits and punctuation such as "?" as
they are. Do not translate, explain, correct, add or drop words: romanize every
word of the query.
Example: ["ખેડૂત આંદોલનના તાજા સમાચાર"] -> ["khedut andolan na taja samachar"]
Answer with a JSON list of strings: one romanized query per input query, in
the same order.
